text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen's ultimate goal, the grand stage of the spring Tenno Sho, is fast approaching.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants her grandmother, the pillar of the Mejiro family, as well as with her other respected relatives, to see her victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The desire to accomplish that burns intensely within her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Mejiro Ryan also decides to compete in the spring Tenno Sho.
